formats.key: swap(address executor, (address srcToken, address dstToken, address srcReceiver, address dstReceiver, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturnAmount, uint256 flags) desc, bytes permit, bytes data)
effects: If permit is non-empty, the router submits the signer's permit for srcToken, setting an allowance with the spender and amount inside the permit bytes.
desc.amount of srcToken is pulled from the signer to desc.srcReceiver, or, when srcToken is ETH (0x0 or 0xEeee), desc.amount of native ETH is sent as msg.value.
When the _REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH flag (bit 1) is set, msg.value may be larger than desc.amount (or nonzero for token swaps), and all of it is forwarded to the executor.
The executor runs the hidden route in data with the signer's funds.
At least minReturnAmount of dstToken (router balance minus 1 wei) goes to dstReceiver, or to the signer when dstReceiver is the zero address.
When the _PARTIAL_FILL flag (bit 0) is set, unspent srcToken is refunded to the signer. The minimum is then only proportional: returnAmount*amount >= minReturnAmount*spentAmount.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send (desc.amount in srcToken), Minimum to Receive (minReturnAmount in dstToken) and Beneficiary (dstReceiver). Executor, srcReceiver, flags, permit and data are hidden, and there is no msg.value field.

findings.title: swap is payable and the extra-ETH flag lets msg.value exceed the shown amount; no value field exists
findings.evidence: AggregationRouterV5.sol GenericRouter.swap: `if (desc.flags & _REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH != 0) { if (msg.value <= (srcETH ? desc.amount : 0)) revert ... }` and _execute forwards `callvalue()` to the executor. Descriptor: desc.flags is `visible: never` and there is no `@.value` field.
findings.fix: Add a field `{path: "@.value", label: "Native value sent", format: "amount"}`, or show desc.flags through an enum noting 'requires extra ETH'.

findings.title: swap labels minReturnAmount a hard minimum, but with partial fill it only bounds the rate
findings.evidence: GenericRouter.swap: `if (desc.flags & _PARTIAL_FILL != 0) { ... spentAmount -= unspentAmount; srcToken.uniTransfer(msg.sender, unspentAmount); ... if (returnAmount * desc.amount < desc.minReturnAmount * spentAmount) revert`. Descriptor: 'Minimum to Receive' on desc.minReturnAmount; desc.flags is `visible: never`.
findings.fix: Show desc.flags (bit 0 = partial fill allowed), or relabel the field 'Minimum to receive (pro rata if partially filled)'.

findings.title: swap Beneficiary shows the zero address literally, though the code then pays the signer
findings.evidence: GenericRouter.swap: `address payable dstReceiver = (desc.dstReceiver == address(0)) ? payable(msg.sender) : desc.dstReceiver;`. Descriptor: field desc.dstReceiver uses the beneficiary definition (addressName) with no handling for zero.
findings.fix: Map addressAsNull to a 'Sender (you)' label, or add a note in the field label.

findings.title: swap hides the executor route and the permit; the router's own check bounds the output
findings.evidence: Descriptor: executor, desc.srcReceiver, permit and data are `visible: never`. GenericRouter.swap pulls tokens to srcReceiver and checks `returnAmount < desc.minReturnAmount` before paying dstReceiver.

findings.title: swap intent is a bare 'Swap' with no tokens or amounts
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `"intent": "Swap"`, no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent such as 'Swap {desc.amount} for at least {desc.minReturnAmount} to {desc.dstReceiver}'.

cases.notes: 17 USDC left the signer, matching Amount to Send. 9074.23 MYTH arrived at the signer, above the shown minimum of 8936.2 MYTH, and the Beneficiary is the signer. Flags = 4, so neither partial fill nor extra ETH applied. msg.value was 0.

formats.key: unoswap(address srcToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, uint256[] pools)
effects: amount of srcToken is pulled from the signer to the first pool, or, when srcToken is 0, msg.value equal to amount is wrapped to WETH and sent to the first pool.
The swap runs through the UniV2-style pairs packed in pools; the output token comes from the last pair.
At least minReturn of the output token goes to the signer, unwrapped to native ETH when the WETH bit of the last pool is set.
formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send (amount in srcToken), Minimum to Receive (minReturn with no token), Beneficiary (the signer) and Last pool (the raw packed pool word).

findings.title: unoswap Minimum to Receive has no token, because the output token is set by the last pool
findings.evidence: Descriptor: minReturn uses minReceiveAmount with no tokenPath. The spec says to show the raw value with an 'Unknown token' warning. UnoswapRouter._unoswap derives the output from the pair, and an ETH or WETH output depends on `and(rawPair, _WETH_MASK)`.

findings.title: unoswap Last pool formats a packed uint256 (flags and numerator) as an address
findings.evidence: UnoswapRouter: `_REVERSE_MASK`, `_WETH_MASK` and `_NUMERATOR_MASK` occupy the high bits of each pools word. Descriptor: field `pools.[-1]` uses lastPool (addressName) with no slice.
findings.fix: Use path `pools.[-1].[-20:]`, or drop the field: a pool address tells the signer little.

findings.title: unoswap intent is a bare 'Swap' with no amounts
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `"intent": "Swap"`, no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent 'Swap {amount} for at least {minReturn}'.

formats.shown: "Swap" with Amount to Send (amount in srcToken), Minimum to Receive (raw, no token), Beneficiary (recipient) and Last pool (raw packed word).

findings.title: unoswapTo Minimum to Receive has no token; the output token is derived from the pool
findings.evidence: Descriptor: minReturn has no tokenPath. UnoswapRouter._unoswap takes the output from the last pair, with the ETH unwrap set by `_WETH_MASK`.

findings.title: unoswapTo Last pool formats a packed uint256 as an address
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `pools.[-1]` uses lastPool (addressName) with no slice. UnoswapRouter packs reverse, WETH and numerator bits above the address.
findings.fix: Slice `pools.[-1].[-20:]` or remove the field.

findings.title: unoswapTo intent 'Swap' does not say the output goes to another recipient
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `"intent": "Swap"`, no interpolatedIntent. The recipient is shown only as a field.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent 'Swap {amount} for at least {minReturn} to {recipient}'.

findings.format: swap(address executor, (address srcToken, address dstToken, address srcReceiver, address dstReceiver, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturnAmount, uint256 flags) desc, bytes permit, bytes data)
findings.title: swap is payable and the extra-ETH flag lets msg.value exceed the shown amount; no value field exists
findings.reason: The extra-ETH branch accepts value beyond the displayed source amount and forwards all of it to the executor. No displayed field states that additional payment.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x1111111254eeb25477b68fb85ed929f73a960582/src/AggregationRouterV5.sol, GenericRouter.swap: `if (desc.flags & _REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH != 0) { if (msg.value <= (srcETH ? desc.amount : 0)) revert RouterErrors.InvalidMsgValue(); }`; GenericRouter._execute: `call(gas(), executor, callvalue(), ptr, add(0x44, data.length), 0, 0)`. descriptor.json, swap: `"path": "desc.amount"`, `"tokenPath": "desc.srcToken"`; `"path": "desc.flags", "visible": "never"`; no `@.value` field.

findings.format: clipperSwap(address clipperExchange, address srcToken, address dstToken, uint256 inputAmount, uint256 outputAmount, uint256 goodUntil, bytes32 r, bytes32 vs)
findings.title: clipperSwap sends the signer's tokens to a calldata-chosen clipperExchange that is hidden
findings.reason: The wrapper transfers through clipperSwapTo to the hidden, caller-selected exchange. A successful no-op exchange call completes without enforcing the displayed output amount.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x1111111254eeb25477b68fb85ed929f73a960582/src/AggregationRouterV5.sol, ClipperRouter.clipperSwap: `return clipperSwapTo(clipperExchange, payable(msg.sender), srcToken, dstToken, inputAmount, outputAmount, goodUntil, r, vs);`; clipperSwapTo: `srcToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(clipperExchange), inputAmount);`, `if iszero(call(gas(), clipper, 0, ptr, 0x169, 0, 0))`, `return outputAmount;`. descriptor.json, clipperSwap: `"label": "Clipper Exchange", "path": "clipperExchange", "visible": "never"`; outputAmount references minReceiveAmount, labelled `"Minimum to Receive"`.

findings.format: clipperSwapTo(address clipperExchange, address recipient, address srcToken, address dstToken, uint256 inputAmount, uint256 outputAmount, uint256 goodUntil, bytes32 r, bytes32 vs)
findings.title: clipperSwapTo sends the signer's tokens to a hidden, calldata-chosen clipperExchange
findings.reason: The input tokens go to an unrestricted calldata address hidden from the signer. For token-to-token swaps, call success alone suffices; the router does not verify the displayed minimum receipt.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x1111111254eeb25477b68fb85ed929f73a960582/src/AggregationRouterV5.sol, ClipperRouter.clipperSwapTo: `srcToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(clipperExchange), inputAmount);`, `address clipper = address(clipperExchange);`, `if iszero(call(gas(), clipper, 0, ptr, 0x169, 0, 0))`, `return outputAmount;`. descriptor.json, clipperSwapTo: `"label": "Clipper Exchange", "path": "clipperExchange", "visible": "never"`; outputAmount references minReceiveAmount, labelled `"Minimum to Receive"`.

findings.format: clipperSwapToWithPermit(address clipperExchange, address recipient, address srcToken, address dstToken, uint256 inputAmount, uint256 outputAmount, uint256 goodUntil, bytes32 r, bytes32 vs, bytes permit)
findings.title: clipperSwapToWithPermit sends the signer's tokens to a hidden, calldata-chosen clipperExchange
findings.reason: Executing the permit does not constrain the exchange address. The subsequent swap transfers tokens to that hidden address without independently enforcing the displayed token output.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x1111111254eeb25477b68fb85ed929f73a960582/src/AggregationRouterV5.sol, ClipperRouter.clipperSwapToWithPermit: `srcToken.safePermit(permit); return clipperSwapTo(clipperExchange, recipient, srcToken, dstToken, inputAmount, outputAmount, goodUntil, r, vs);`; clipperSwapTo: `srcToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(clipperExchange), inputAmount);`, `return outputAmount;`. descriptor.json, clipperSwapToWithPermit: `"path": "clipperExchange", "visible": "never"`; outputAmount references minReceiveAmount, labelled `"Minimum to Receive"`.

findings.format: unoswap(address srcToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, uint256[] pools)
findings.title: unoswap is payable, and no field shows the ETH sent (@.value)
findings.reason: Native value must equal the displayed amount; token-input swaps reject any native value. The value is shown through another field, covered by not-critical item 2.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x1111111254eeb25477b68fb85ed929f73a960582/src/AggregationRouterV5.sol, UnoswapRouter.unoswap calls _unoswap; _unoswap: `case 0 { if iszero(eq(amount, callvalue())) { ... revert(0, 4) } }`, `default { if callvalue() { ... revert(0, 4) } }`. descriptor.json, unoswap: `"path": "amount", "$ref": "$.display.definitions.sendAmount", "params": { "tokenPath": "srcToken" }, "visible": "always"`.

findings.format: unoswapTo(address recipient, address srcToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, uint256[] pools)
findings.title: unoswapTo is payable, and no field shows the ETH sent (@.value)
findings.reason: The shared implementation requires native value to equal the displayed amount and rejects it for token inputs. A separate value field is unnecessary for this finding.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x1111111254eeb25477b68fb85ed929f73a960582/src/AggregationRouterV5.sol, UnoswapRouter.unoswapTo: `return _unoswap(recipient, srcToken, amount, minReturn, pools);`; _unoswap: `if iszero(eq(amount, callvalue())) { ... revert(0, 4) }`, token branch: `if callvalue() { ... revert(0, 4) }`. descriptor.json, unoswapTo: `"path": "amount", "$ref": "$.display.definitions.sendAmount", "params": { "tokenPath": "srcToken" }, "visible": "always"`.

findings.format: uniswapV3Swap(uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, uint256[] pools)
findings.title: uniswapV3Swap is payable, and no field shows the ETH sent (@.value)
findings.reason: Every nonzero native payment must equal the displayed amount. Missing token context does not make a displayed amount hidden under not-critical items 1 and 2.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x1111111254eeb25477b68fb85ed929f73a960582/src/AggregationRouterV5.sol, UniswapV3Router.uniswapV3Swap calls _uniswapV3Swap; _uniswapV3Swap: `bool wrapWeth = msg.value > 0;`, `if (wrapWeth) { if (msg.value != amount) revert RouterErrors.InvalidMsgValue(); _WETH.deposit{value: amount}(); }`. descriptor.json, uniswapV3Swap: `"path": "amount", "$ref": "$.display.definitions.sendAmount", "visible": "always"`.

findings.format: uniswapV3SwapTo(address recipient, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, uint256[] pools)
findings.title: uniswapV3SwapTo is payable, and no field shows the ETH sent (@.value)
findings.reason: Nonzero native value is constrained to the displayed amount by the shared implementation. The severity guide excludes values shown through another field, even without token context.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x1111111254eeb25477b68fb85ed929f73a960582/src/AggregationRouterV5.sol, UniswapV3Router.uniswapV3SwapTo: `return _uniswapV3Swap(recipient, amount, minReturn, pools);`; _uniswapV3Swap: `bool wrapWeth = msg.value > 0;`, `if (wrapWeth) { if (msg.value != amount) revert RouterErrors.InvalidMsgValue(); _WETH.deposit{value: amount}(); }`. descriptor.json, uniswapV3SwapTo: `"path": "amount", "$ref": "$.display.definitions.sendAmount", "visible": "always"`.

findings.format: clipperSwap(address clipperExchange, address srcToken, address dstToken, uint256 inputAmount, uint256 outputAmount, uint256 goodUntil, bytes32 r, bytes32 vs)
findings.title: clipperSwap is payable, and no field shows the ETH sent (@.value)
findings.reason: clipperSwap inherits checks requiring native value to equal the displayed inputAmount for ETH inputs. Both WETH and other token inputs reject nonzero value.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x1111111254eeb25477b68fb85ed929f73a960582/src/AggregationRouterV5.sol, ClipperRouter.clipperSwap calls clipperSwapTo; clipperSwapTo: `if (srcETH) { if (msg.value != inputAmount) revert RouterErrors.InvalidMsgValue(); }`; both other branches: `if (msg.value != 0) revert RouterErrors.InvalidMsgValue();`. descriptor.json, clipperSwap: `"path": "inputAmount", "$ref": "$.display.definitions.sendAmount", "params": { "tokenPath": "srcToken" }, "visible": "always"`.

findings.format: clipperSwapTo(address clipperExchange, address recipient, address srcToken, address dstToken, uint256 inputAmount, uint256 outputAmount, uint256 goodUntil, bytes32 r, bytes32 vs)
findings.title: clipperSwapTo is payable, and no field shows the ETH sent (@.value)
findings.reason: ETH value equals the displayed inputAmount, and every non-ETH input branch rejects native value. This is a value shown through another field, not a hidden payment.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x1111111254eeb25477b68fb85ed929f73a960582/src/AggregationRouterV5.sol, ClipperRouter.clipperSwapTo: `if (srcETH) { if (msg.value != inputAmount) revert RouterErrors.InvalidMsgValue(); }`; WETH and other-token branches: `if (msg.value != 0) revert RouterErrors.InvalidMsgValue();`. descriptor.json, clipperSwapTo: `"path": "inputAmount", "$ref": "$.display.definitions.sendAmount", "params": { "tokenPath": "srcToken" }, "visible": "always"`.
